about: Synthetic samples of a subscription-shaped credential, for T1a-28's classifier. Every value is made up. The rules and their sources: README.md beside this file (T1a-18, R-711).

samples.name: claude_plan_bearer
samples.label: claude-plan
samples.note: What Claude Code sends on a plan: its OAuth access token as a bearer, with the OAuth beta.

samples.name: claude_plan_bearer_without_the_beta
samples.label: claude-plan
samples.note: The token decides; the anthropic-beta marker is not needed.

samples.name: claude_plan_bearer_scheme_in_lower_case
samples.label: claude-plan
samples.note: The auth scheme is case-insensitive (RFC 9110 §11.1).

samples.name: claude_plan_token_in_x_api_key
samples.label: claude-plan
samples.note: A plan token where an API key belongs is still a plan token.

samples.name: claude_plan_refresh_token
samples.label: claude-plan
samples.note: A refresh token is never sent to Messages, but if it arrives it is a plan credential.

samples.name: claude_plan_token_beside_another_credential
samples.label: claude-plan
samples.note: Any credential header carrying a plan token makes the request subscription-shaped, even beside the run's token.

samples.name: chatgpt_plan_bearer_with_account_header
samples.label: chatgpt-plan
samples.note: What Codex sends on a ChatGPT sign-in: the access token (a JWT) as a bearer, with the account header.

samples.name: chatgpt_plan_bearer_without_account_header
samples.label: chatgpt-plan
samples.note: The JWT's OpenAI auth claim decides; the account header is not needed.

samples.name: anthropic_api_key_in_x_api_key
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: An Anthropic API key, as Claude Code sends one.

samples.name: anthropic_api_key_as_bearer
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: An API key set in ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN.

samples.name: anthropic_admin_key
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: An Admin API key is a key, not a plan sign-in.

samples.name: the_runs_token_as_hex
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: The run's token, 32 bytes, if T1a-05 encodes it as hex.

samples.name: the_runs_token_as_base64url
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: The same 32 bytes, if T1a-05 encodes them as unpadded base64url.

samples.name: no_credential_header
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: No credential at all.

samples.name: empty_authorization
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: An empty header.

samples.name: bearer_with_no_token
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: A scheme with no token.

samples.name: empty_x_api_key
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: An empty key.

samples.name: garbled_authorization
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: Garbled bytes.

samples.name: plan_prefix_under_another_scheme
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: Not a bearer, so not where the token belongs.

samples.name: plan_prefix_not_at_the_start
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: The prefix must open the value.

samples.name: a_jwt_without_openais_claim
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: Some other issuer's JWT is not a ChatGPT sign-in.

samples.name: three_segments_that_are_not_a_jwt
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: A garbled JWT.

samples.name: claude_code_session_ingress_token
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: sk-ant-si- is a remote session's ingress token, not a plan sign-in.

samples.name: openai_api_key
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: An OpenAI API key is a key, not a plan sign-in.

samples.name: chatgpt_account_header_alone
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: Open question Q3: the account header alone carries no credential, so it does not classify.

samples.name: claude_ai_web_session_key
samples.label: not-subscription
samples.note: Open question Q2: a claude.ai web session key in a cookie is not where the run's token belongs, so it does not classify.
